subject: general
question: In which year did Motilal Nehru chair the committee to prepare the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1928**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Motilal Nehru** chaired a committee responsible for drafting the constitution in **1928**.
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** was the **secretary **of the committee.
 
• The constitution drafted by the committee was termed as **Nehru committee report or Nehru Report**.
 
• The Nehru report was submitted on **the 28th of August 1928** by **Motilal Nehru at an all-party conference held in Lucknow.**
 
• Some other members of the committee were Subhash Chandra Bose, Mangal Singh, Tej Bahadur Sapru, Ali Imam etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The committee was made in protest against **Simon Commission introduced in India by Britishers in 1928.**
 
• The commission was aggressively opposed** because there was no Indian member in that.**
 
• Responding to the protest against the** Simon Commission the Secretary of State of India at that time Lord BIrkinhead challenged India's political leader to prepare a draft of the constitution.**
 
• Indian leaders **accepted the challenge and prepared a draft of the constitution**.
 
• Some of the recommendations of the Nehru report were:
 
 
• **Dominion Status **
 
• **Equal Rights for men and women**
 
• **No State Religion**
 
• **Supreme Court**
 
• **Reservation for minorities**
